llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define and register a Notifications screen route in the stack navigator.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Notifications screen is defined as NotificationsScreen and registered in the stack navigator under the key 'Notifications'.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must model filter as an optional navigation param for the notifications screen.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: filter is accessed via optional chaining on params (`Navigation.useStaticRoute().params ?? { filter: 'all' }`), making it effectively optional. No explicit type annotation forces it as required.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must default filter to all when the param is absent.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: When params is absent/undefined, the nullish coalescing fallback sets filter to 'all'.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render the normalized filter value in the screen UI.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The filter value is rendered directly in the UI inside a Text component as 'Notifications: {filter}'.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must construct navigation with React Navigation static API and render it via `createStaticNavigation(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createStaticNavigation is imported from @react-navigation/native, used to construct Navigation, and rendered as <Navigation /> in App.
